description: Sea-state forecast for a sea point in northern European waters (Norwegian Sea, North Sea, Skagerrak, Barents Sea and nearby north-east Atlantic, including UK coastal waters): hourly significant wave height and direction, surface current speed and direction, and sea temperature. For sailing, kayaking, fishing trips and coastal swims. Source: MET Norway Oceanforecast 2.0 (nearest model sea point). Not a navigational or safety product; points on land or outside the model area return no rows. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, how many hours ahead from the current hour (1-72), default 24

lat.description: number, required, latitude of a sea point in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude of a sea point in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: marine_forecast
